root.summary: The operator cannot apply the declared Database "orders-reporting".
root.detail: The declaration exists but its effect does not: whatever expects this database, role, publication or subscription to be there finds it missing or outdated. The operator's own message below names the refusal, and nothing changes until its cause is fixed.

evidence.detail: applied false: role "reporter" does not exist

root.summary: The Kubernetes server version no longer receives upstream patches.
root.detail: Kubernetes patches each minor for about fourteen months, so bug and security fixes are no longer published for this one. Where support ends is the lifecycle table's claim, quoted below with the version it is applied to.

evidence.detail: Kubernetes 1.34 left upstream support on 2026-10-27; table reviewed 2026-11-02

root.summary: The pgdata volume of orders-1 will be full in about 8 days (2026-11-06 11:37 UTC).
root.detail: A robust fit of the last 168 hours grows 1.0 GiB a day, high confidence. The earliest plausible date is 2026-11-06 11:37 UTC.
root.nextSteps: Raise the storage size (the storage class must allow expansion), or find and stop the growth.

root.summary: No restore drill run from this console has passed for this Cluster in the last 90 days.
root.detail: A backup is proven restorable only by restoring it. A drill restores the latest backup into a throwaway Cluster, checks it and deletes it; its duration is the measured recovery time. Drills run by hand or by another console are not in this console's record.

evidence.detail: no drill of this Cluster recorded since 2026-04-12

root.nextSteps: Run a restore drill from the Backups screen.
